# The low sun: a faceted gold disc 1.6 m across facing the camera, a cream core. Unlit. Origin at its
# centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sun --base-color 1.000 0.878 0.494 --no-slot --emission 1.000 0.878 0.494
material new Core --base-color 1.000 0.906 0.839 --no-slot --emission 1.000 0.906 0.839
add mesh cylinder --name Sun --vertices 12 --radius 0.8 --depth 0.1 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Sun
add mesh cylinder --name Core --vertices 12 --radius 0.5 --depth 0.1 --location 0 -0.06 0 --rotation 90 0 0
material assign Core
shade flat
export sun.glb
